findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The Quaternary ammonium sanitizer buckets were observed to test at a concentration of 100ppm. CORRECTED- The PIC was informed and they changed all sanitizer buckets. The sanitizer buckets tested to be at the label-recommended concentration of 200ppm. Ensure that sanitizer buckets are frequently tested and changed if not at the label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: The inspectors observed fry containers in a dispenser with their food-contact surface exposed to contamination next to the fryers (near drive through window). Ensure that single-service articles and utensils are inverted to prevent contamination of food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The sides of the fryers.
2. The table holding the fry baskets to the right of the fryers. 
3. The shelf holding receipt paper and copy paper to the right of the fryers, across from the office desk. 
4. The shelf in the back kitchen preparation area to the right of the preparation table holding the slicer. 
5. The walk-in cooler shelves. 
6. The rack and the sheet pans holding containers of food in the walk-in cooler. 

This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: The mop sink faucet is observed to have a dripping leak coming from it. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that plumbing systems are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The air vent grates above the clean dish shelves by the triple sink. 
2. The floor of the walk-in freezer. 
3. The wall behind the soda syrup boxes/shelf. 

This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1.The coving behind the soda syrup boxes is observed to be coming away from the wall. Ensure that coving is sealed to the wall. 
2.The coving to the left of the back door is cracked and needs to be replaced.
3.The coving to the right side of the door is observed to be coming away from the wall. Ensure that the coving is sealed to the wall.

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed 2 chlorinated bleach bottles, as well as the dispenser on the wall to be at 0 ppm Cl. Chlorine sanitizer must be measured between 50-200 ppm Cl to effectively sanitize food contact surfaces. A follow up inspection will occur on 08/29/25 to ensure that the chlorine sanitizer dispenser is dispensing sanitizer solution at an appropriate concentration. Use quaternary ammonia solution to clean food contact surfaces until the chlorine dispenser is serviced and observed dispensing the appropriate concentration of sanitizer.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT: An accumulation of grease was observed on the hood, baffles, and fire suppression nozzles of the hood vent system over the facility’s fryer. Grease drips pose a threat of contamination on ready to eat foods, and also pose a fire risk to the facility. Physical facilities must be cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of grease or other debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a significant amount of debris and soil accumulation underneath the soda boxes in the facility’s dry storage area. The harborage of soil accumulation may attract pests. Facilities should be cleaned at a frequency to prevent the build up of soil debris. Ensure shelving is being moved to clean the floors.

(B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Crumbs/food debris accumulation was observed inside and on the gaskets of the fry station freezer. Clean the freezer as frequently as needed to prevent soil accumulation.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.comment:
